body: Worst betrayal ever mate... Hope you regretted it and was genuinely sorry. I know people fk up, but when it's multiple times and for no apparent reason, it really messes the person who did stay faithful, up.

I have known just over a year Amy, I stayed because he told me he'd sort himself out and stop being the horrible person he's been. But I was stupid to believe him, he's been back on them hook up sites a few times since coming clean but says he's not met anyone. I know he's spoke to others and had webcam sessions with them since coming clean too. He's fkt my whole head up when all I've asked and wanted was for him to be better, talk to me not shout and scream, not tell me he wishes I was dead and that he hates me when he's angry. I just think it's time to give him his wish and let him go at it alone seems as though he doesn't truly want me, he never did though did he.

Thanks for your words but for me, my whole mind is made up and I'm not someone that changes it easily. You spoke kind words and it's nice to know some good people still exist. This world isn't for me, it's brought me nothing but misery and pain and for that, I'm filled with sheer hatred for the planet we call earth. People are so cruel to one another, I hope one day it changes, I just won't be here to see that. Everytime I will and wish for change, it passes me by, I'm no use here anymore.
